headline: Eurasian Minerals Sells Haiti Joint Venture Interests for US $4 Million and an NSR Royalty
summary:
VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA--(Marketwired - Nov. 2, 2015) -Eurasian Minerals Inc. (the "Company" or "EMX") (TSX VENTURE:EMX)(NYSE MKT:EMXX) is pleased to announce the sale of its interests in Haiti to joint venture partner Newmont Ventures Limited ("Newmont" or "NVL"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Newmont Mining Corporation (NYSE:NEM), for a US $4 million (CAD $5.3 million) cash payment and a retained 0.5% net smelter return ("NSR") royalty interest.

headline: Cornerstone Announces Termination of Macara Project (Ecuador) Strategic Alliance Agreement
summary:

("Cornerstone" or "the Company") (TSX VENTURE:CGP)(FRANKFURT:GWN)(BERLIN:GWN)(OTCBB:CTNXF) announces that it has received a letter from Newmont Ventures Limited, a subsidiary of Newmont Mining Corporation ("Newmont") (NYSE:NEM), terminating the Strategic Alliance and Venture Agreement between them dated February 11, 2008 concerning the Macara project in southern Ecuador.
